verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents its own performance reporting: you can prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how the Customer Agent is performing, and the Releases page lets you track the impact of configuration changes. Neither source names the specific KPIs or describes a persistent dashboard. missing for 10: a documented analytics dashboard, explicit resolution-rate, CSAT, handoff-rate and cost-per-resolution metrics, exec-ready reporting or export, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team

citations.quote: Prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short.
Configuration actions publish as a release on the Releases page, where you can track the impact and revert with one click.
